tasks.title: Add pre-commit hooks for fmt, vet, lint, conventional commits
tasks.description: Add .pre-commit-config.yaml using the pre-commit framework. Hooks: trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, check-yaml, check-merge-conflict, check-added-large-files (--maxkb=500), mixed-line-ending; Go-specific: gofmt, go vet, go-mod-tidy; golangci-lint v2.1.6 (matching CI); commit-msg: conventional-pre-commit. Update README with `pre-commit install` instructions. The hooks must be a strict subset of what CI already runs, so a passing pre-commit guarantees CI will not reject on style/lint.

tasks.title: Wire nox vulnerability / SBOM scanning into CI and releases
tasks.description: Add nox vulnerability scanning, SBOM generation, and VEX status reporting to the release pipeline. SBOM should be published as a release artefact alongside the binary archives. Findings should fail CI when severity exceeds a configured threshold. If nox provides a GitHub Action, prefer that; otherwise wire the CLI in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Document the threshold and how to suppress false positives in docs/security.md.

tasks.title: Wire coverctl coverage gating into CI
tasks.description: Establish a coverage baseline via coverctl, then gate PRs on regressions beyond a configured threshold and post a PR comment with the diff. Replace or complement the current Codecov upload depending on which fits better. Capture the baseline in .coverctl/ (or wherever coverctl persists state) and document the workflow in CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/quality.md.

tasks.title: Add Homebrew tap distribution via goreleaser
tasks.description: Add a brews: block to .goreleaser.yaml pointing at a homebrew-tap repository (felixgeelhaar/homebrew-tap or similar). Configure formula name, description, license, dependencies (none for a static binary), and test stanza (`chronos version`). On release, goreleaser will commit the formula update to the tap automatically. Document the install command in README.

tasks.title: Add .deb / .rpm packages via goreleaser
tasks.description: Add an nfpms: block to .goreleaser.yaml producing .deb (Debian/Ubuntu) and .rpm (RHEL/Fedora) packages. Configure maintainer, description, license, package name, and install paths (binary at /usr/local/bin/chronos). Packages publish alongside the existing tar.gz archives in the GitHub Release.

tasks.title: Document all install channels in README
tasks.description: Extend README's 'Install' section so users see every distribution option side-by-side: `go install`, prebuilt binary download (with checksum verification), Docker (`docker run ghcr.io/felixgeelhaar/chronos`), Homebrew (once available), .deb/.rpm (once available). Note the supported OS/arch matrix.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Anomaly
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Anomaly. Cross-entity dual of Recurrence. For each entity's most recent state,
cosine-compare to peers' most recent states; emit when highest peer similarity
is below AnomalyMaxSimilarity. Strength = 1 - max_similarity. Evidence kind
peer_distance, one per peer.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Stall
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Stall. Normalised stddev of outcomes below StallMaxStdDev over at least StallMinPoints.
Strength reflects flatness (1 - normalised_stddev / threshold). Evidence kind
variance_window.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Recurrence
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Recurrence. For each entity's most recent state, look at strictly historical states of
OTHER entities in the same scope. Cosine similarity ≥ threshold counts as a
similar peer. Strength = avg(peer similarity). Confidence = strength × min(samples/5, 1).
Evidence kind similar_state with metrics["outcome_diff"] = peer.outcome - subject.outcome.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Correlation
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Correlation. Pairwise Pearson on aligned outcome series within a scope. One signal per pair,
deterministically owned by the lex-smaller series ID; the other appears as evidence.
Strength = |r|; metrics carry r and direction. Evidence kind pair_correlation.
Cost is O(N²) in series count per scope.

tasks.title: Document stable evidence kinds and metrics keys as wire contract
tasks.description: Detector emissions use stable string keys (similar_state, regression_summary, baseline_deviation, variance_window, peer_distance, autocorrelation_peak, pair_correlation) and metric names (outcome_diff, slope, intercept, r2, n, z, baseline_mean, baseline_stddev, observed_outcome, normalised_stddev, max_peer_similarity, peer_count, period, autocorrelation, r, abs_r, direction, avg_similarity, sample_size, avg_outcome_diff, mean, window). These are de-facto wire contract for any consumer that switches on Evidence.Kind or reads Metrics[k]. Add a 'Stable wire keys' section to docs/cognitive-stack.md (or a new docs/wire-contract.md) listing every kind and key per detector so future renames are recognised as breaking changes.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Spike / Drop
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Spike / Drop. Z-score of most recent outcome against previous SpikeWindow points. Trigger:
|z| >= threshold in configured direction. Strength = min(|z|/5, 1); metrics
carry z, baseline mean / stddev. Evidence kind baseline_deviation.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Seasonality
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Seasonality. Pearson autocorrelation at lags [MinPeriod, n/2]. Emit when largest peak exceeds
SeasonalityMinAutocorr. Strength = peak value; metrics carry the period (lag).
Evidence kind autocorrelation_peak.
